# DressYou

> DressYou is the social fashion app. Try on clothes from any shop on your twin, style your wardrobe, ask your AI stylist and share looks with friends.

En français : DressYou est l’app mode sociale. Essayez les vêtements de toute boutique sur votre jumeau, créez vos tenues, demandez à votre styliste IA et partagez vos looks.

Your own photos make your twin, and you try on clothes from any online shop, your wardrobe or the feed before you buy. The app also builds outfits from the clothes you own, lets friends vote between looks, and includes a stylist that answers from your wardrobe. The app is not released yet. iOS, Android and a Chrome extension are announced, and the site takes an email to say when it is out.


## Facts

- Name: DressYou
- Company: DressYou Technologies, 47 rue Vivienne, 75002 Paris, France
- Site: https://dressyouapp.com/ in English, https://dressyouapp.com/fr in French
- Contact: info@dressyouapp.com
- Status: pre-launch
